query:
SELECT id, title, LENGTH(content) as content_len, 
  (LENGTH(content) - LENGTH(REPLACE(content, '<svg', ''))) / 4 as svg_count
FROM course_lessons 
WHERE content LIKE '%<svg%' OR content LIKE '%symbol%' OR content LIKE '%schematic%'
ORDER BY svg_count DESC
LIMIT 50;
